Who we are

Expertise meets compassion, on Yas Island.

Welcome to Tham Oralcare, where expertise meets compassion. Located in the heart of Abu Dhabi, our clinic is led by a team of highly skilled dentists dedicated to delivering exceptional oral healthcare — from children to seniors, with comprehensive dental solutions tailored to each patient's needs.

Our mission is to empower patients with healthy and confident smiles through cutting-edge dental care and genuine patient relationships — preventive care, transparent communication, and a personalized experience for everyone who walks through our doors.

"...that life is still worthwhile, if you just smile."Written on the clinic wall, Tham Oralcare
